title: DS6050: discGAN: distributed, tabular GAN
summary: A UVA DS6050 course project that builds a distributed, conditional GAN (discGAN) for generating synthetic eICU healthcare tabular data, and separately modifies CTGAN to support multi-GPU distributed training of its generator and discriminator. The project vendors and edits CTGAN's synthesizer source in-tree and also calls SDV's evaluation utilities to score generated data quality.
evidence: CTGAN_Distribution/ctgan/synthesizers/ctgan.py modified to add distribute_g/distribute_d args using torch DataParallel; README.md:25
needs: TVAESynthesizer is vendored in ctgan/__init__.py but no call site confirms it was actually run in this repo.
